contracts.title: Program payment evidence and account review
contracts.authority: Development evidence prerequisites; not an installed payer contract or verified eligibility rule.

requirements.needed: Source agreement, parties, version, effective dates and supersession rules.
Contract performance and payment periods, runout and finalization rules.
Measure specification, denominator, exclusions, benchmarks and payment formula with source clauses.
Contract-specific patient attribution and eligible observation periods; coverage and assigned PCP alone are insufficient.
Source-linked program delivery, consent and contract-defined outcomes; staff-reported completion alone is insufficient.
